def test_returns_dict(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)

def test_key_set(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    flattened = [value for values in x['d'].values() for value in values]
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    assert set(answer) == set(flattened)

def test_counts_each_input_value(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    flattened = [value for values in x['d'].values() for value in values]
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    assert all(answer.get(value) == flattened.count(value) for value in set(flattened))

def test_no_extra_keys(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    flattened = [value for values in x['d'].values() for value in values]
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    assert all(key in flattened for key in answer)

def test_positive_counts(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    assert all(isinstance(count, int) and count > 0 for count in answer.values())

def test_total_multiplicity(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    flattened = [value for values in x['d'].values() for value in values]
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    assert sum(answer.values()) == len(flattened)

def test_exact_frequency_map(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    expected = {}
    for values in x['d'].values():
        for value in values:
            expected[value] = expected.get(value, 0) + 1
    assert answer == expected

def test_counts_match_recount(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    flattened = [value for values in x['d'].values() for value in values]
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    assert all(count == sum(value == key for value in flattened) for key, count in answer.items())

def test_empty_and_nonempty_shape(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    flattened = [value for values in x['d'].values() for value in values]
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    assert bool(answer) == bool(flattened)

def test_counter_oracle(run, x):
    from collections import Counter
    answer = run(x)
    flattened = [value for values in x['d'].values() for value in values]
    assert answer == dict(Counter(flattened))

def test_returns_dict(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)

def test_keys_are_input_integers(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    source_values = {v for values in x['d'].values() for v in values}
    assert all(type(key) is int and key in source_values for key in answer)

def test_counts_are_positive_integers(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    assert all(type(count) is int and count > 0 for count in answer.values())

def test_key_set_exact(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    expected_keys = {value for values in x['d'].values() for value in values}
    assert set(answer) == expected_keys

def test_count_certificate(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    values = [value for group in x['d'].values() for value in group]
    assert all(answer[key] == sum(value == key for value in values) for key in answer)

def test_input_keys_counted(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    values = [value for group in x['d'].values() for value in group]
    missing = object()
    assert all(answer.get(key, missing) == values.count(key) for key in set(values))

def test_total_occurrences(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    assert all(type(count) is int for count in answer.values())
    total = sum(len(values) for values in x['d'].values())
    assert sum(answer.values()) == total

def test_bruteforce_mapping(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    values = [value for group in x['d'].values() for value in group]
    expected = {key: values.count(key) for key in values}
    assert answer == expected

def test_per_list_contributions(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    keys = {value for group in x['d'].values() for value in group}
    missing = object()
    assert all(answer.get(key, missing) == sum(group.count(key) for group in x['d'].values()) for key in keys)

def test_empty_case(run, x):
    answer = run(x)
    assert isinstance(answer, dict)
    has_values = any(values for values in x['d'].values())
    assert has_values or answer == {}
